| G-PI-CHANGELOG-604 | CHANGELOG.md | Fixed TUI width handling for regional indicator symbols to prevent wrap drift and stale characters during streaming ([#1783](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/issues/1783)). |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-605 | CHANGELOG.md | Fixed Kitty CSIu handling to ignore unsupported modifiers so modifieronly events do not insert printable characters ([#1807](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/issues/1807)). |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-606 | CHANGELOG.md | Fixed singleline paste handling to insert text atomically and avoid repeated `@` autocomplete scans on large pastes ([#1812](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/issues/1812)). |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-607 | CHANGELOG.md | Fixed extension loading with the new `@mariozechner/piai/oauth` export path by aliasing the oauth subpath in the extension loader and development path mapping ([#1814](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/issues/1814)). |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-608 | CHANGELOG.md | Fixed browsersafe provider loading regressions by preloading the Bedrock provider module in compiled Bun binaries and rebuilding binaries against fresh workspace dependencies ([#1814](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/issues/1814)). |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-609 | CHANGELOG.md | Fixed GNU screen terminal detection by downgrading theme output to 256color mode for `screen` TERM values ([#1809](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/issues/1809)). |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-610 | CHANGELOG.md | Fixed branch summarization queue handling so messages typed while summaries are generated are processed correctly ([#1803](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/issues/1803)). |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-611 | CHANGELOG.md | Fixed compaction summary requests to avoid reasoning output for nonreasoning models ([#1793](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/issues/1793)). |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-612 | CHANGELOG.md | Fixed overflow autocompaction cascades so a single overflow does not trigger repeated compaction loops. |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-613 | CHANGELOG.md | Fixed `models.json` to allow providerscoped custom model ids and modellevel `baseUrl` overrides ([#1759](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/issues/1759), [#1777](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/issues/1777)). |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-614 | CHANGELOG.md | Fixed session selector display sanitization by stripping control characters from session display text ([#1747](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/issues/1747)). |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-615 | CHANGELOG.md | Fixed Groq Qwen3 reasoning effort mapping for OpenAIcompatible models ([#1745](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/issues/1745)). |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-616 | CHANGELOG.md | Fixed Bedrock `AWS_PROFILE` region resolution by honoring profile `region` values ([#1800](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/issues/1800)). |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-617 | CHANGELOG.md | Fixed Gemini 3.1 thinkinglevel detection for `google` and `googlevertex` providers ([#1785](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/issues/1785)). |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-618 | CHANGELOG.md | Fixed browser bundling compatibility for `@mariozechner/piai` by removing Nodeonly side effects from default browser import paths ([#1814](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/issues/1814)). |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-619 | CHANGELOG.md | Runtime tool registration now applies immediately in active sessions. Tools registered via `pi.registerTool()` after startup are available to `pi.getAllTools()` and the LLM without `/reload` ([docs/extensions.md](docs/extensions.md), [examples/extensions/dynamictools.ts](examples/extensions/dynamictools.ts), [#1720](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/issues/1720)). |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-620 | CHANGELOG.md | Tool definitions can customize the default system prompt with `promptSnippet` (`Available tools`) and `promptGuidelines` (`Guidelines`) while the tool is active ([docs/extensions.md](docs/extensions.md), [#1720](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/issues/1720)). |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-621 | CHANGELOG.md | Custom tool renderers can suppress transcript output without leaving extra spacing or empty transcript footprint in interactive rendering ([docs/extensions.md](docs/extensions.md), [#1719](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/pull/1719)). |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-622 | CHANGELOG.md | Added optional `promptSnippet` to `ToolDefinition` for oneline entries in the default system prompt's `Available tools` section. Active extension tools appear there when registered and active ([#1237](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/pull/1237) by [@semtexzv](https://github.com/semtexzv)). |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-623 | CHANGELOG.md | Added optional `promptGuidelines` to `ToolDefinition` so active tools can append toolspecific bullets to the default system prompt `Guidelines` section ([#1720](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/issues/1720)). |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-624 | CHANGELOG.md | Fixed `pi.registerTool()` dynamic registration after session initialization. Tools registered in `session_start` and later handlers now refresh immediately, become active, and are visible to the LLM without `/reload` ([#1720](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/issues/1720)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-625 | CHANGELOG.md | Fixed session message persistence ordering by serializing `AgentSession` event processing, preventing `toolResult` entries from being written before their corresponding assistant toolcall messages when extension handlers are asynchronous ([#1717](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/issues/1717)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-626 | CHANGELOG.md | Fixed spacing artifacts when custom tool renderers intentionally suppress percall transcript output, including extra blank rows in interactive streaming and nonzero transcript footprint for empty custom renders ([#1719](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/pull/1719) by [@alasano](https://github.com/alasano)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-627 | CHANGELOG.md | Fixed `session.prompt()` returning before retry completion by creating the retry promise synchronously at `agent_end` dispatch, which closes a race when earlier queued event handlers are async ([#1726](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/pull/1726) by [@pasky](https://github.com/pasky)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-628 | CHANGELOG.md | Changed the default image paste keybinding on Windows to `alt+v` to avoid `ctrl+v` conflicts with terminal paste behavior ([#1682](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/pull/1682) by [@mrexodia](https://github.com/mrexodia)). |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-629 | CHANGELOG.md | Extensions can dynamically remove custom providers via `pi.unregisterProvider(name)`, restoring any builtin models that were overridden, without requiring `/reload` ([docs](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/blob/main/packages/codingagent/docs/customprovider.md)). |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-630 | CHANGELOG.md | `pi.registerProvider()` now takes effect immediately when called outside the initial extension load phase (e.g. from a command handler), removing the need for `/reload` after late registrations. |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-631 | CHANGELOG.md | `pi.unregisterProvider(name)` removes a dynamically registered provider and its models from the registry without requiring `/reload`. Builtin models that were overridden by the provider are restored ([#1669](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/pull/1669) by [@aliou](https://github.com/aliou)). |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-632 | CHANGELOG.md | `pi.registerProvider()` now takes effect immediately when called after the initial extension load phase (e.g. from a command handler). Previously the registration sat in a pending queue that was never flushed until the next `/reload` ([#1669](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/pull/1669) by [@aliou](https://github.com/aliou)). |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-633 | CHANGELOG.md | Fixed duplicate session headers when forking from a point before any assistant message. `createBranchedSession` now defers file creation to `_persist()` when the branched path has no assistant message, matching the `newSession()` contract ([#1672](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/pull/1672) by [@wwinter](https://github.com/wwinter)). |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-634 | CHANGELOG.md | Fixed SIGINT being delivered to pi while the process is suspended (e.g. via `ctrl+z`), which could corrupt terminal state on resume ([#1668](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/pull/1668) by [@aliou](https://github.com/aliou)). |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-635 | CHANGELOG.md | Fixed Z.ai thinking control using wrong parameter name, causing thinking to always be enabled and wasting tokens/latency ([#1674](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/pull/1674) by [@okuyam2y](https://github.com/okuyam2y)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-636 | CHANGELOG.md | Fixed `redacted_thinking` blocks being silently dropped during Anthropic streaming, and related issues with interleavedthinking beta headers and temperature being sent alongside extended thinking ([#1665](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/pull/1665) by [@tctev](https://github.com/tctev)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-637 | CHANGELOG.md | Fixed `(external, cli)` useragent flag causing 401 errors on Anthropic setuptoken endpoint ([#1677](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/pull/1677) by [@LazerLance777](https://github.com/LazerLance777)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-638 | CHANGELOG.md | Fixed crash when OpenAIcompatible provider returns a chunk with no `choices` array ([#1671](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/issues/1671)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-639 | CHANGELOG.md | Added offline startup mode via `offline` (or `PI_OFFLINE`) to disable startup network operations, with startup network timeouts to avoid hangs in restricted or offline environments. |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-640 | CHANGELOG.md | Added `gemini3.1propreview` model support to the `googlegeminicli` provider ([#1599](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/pull/1599) by [@audichuang](https://github.com/audichuang)). |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-641 | CHANGELOG.md | Fixed offline startup hangs by adding offline startup behavior and network timeouts during managed tool setup ([#1631](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/pull/1631) by [@mcollina](https://github.com/mcollina)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-642 | CHANGELOG.md | Fixed Windows VT input initialization in ESM by loading koffi via createRequire, avoiding runtime and bundling issues in enduser environments ([#1627](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/pull/1627) by [@kaste](https://github.com/kaste)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-643 | CHANGELOG.md | Fixed managed `fd`/`rg` bootstrap on Windows in Git Bash by using `extractzip` for `.zip` archives, searching extracted layouts more robustly, and isolating extraction temp directories to avoid concurrent download races ([#1348](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/issues/1348)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-644 | CHANGELOG.md | Fixed extension loading on Windows when resolving `@sinclair/typebox` aliases so subpath imports like `@sinclair/typebox/compiler` resolve correctly. |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-645 | CHANGELOG.md | Fixed adaptive thinking for Claude Sonnet 4.6 in Anthropic and Bedrock providers, and clamped unsupported `xhigh` effort values to supported levels ([#1548](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/pull/1548) by [@tctev](https://github.com/tctev)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-646 | CHANGELOG.md | Fixed Vertex ADC credential detection race by avoiding caching a false negative during async import initialization ([#1550](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/pull/1550) by [@jeremiahgaylordweb](https://github.com/jeremiahgaylordweb)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-647 | CHANGELOG.md | Fixed subagent extension example to resolve user agents from the configured agent directory instead of hardcoded paths ([#1559](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/pull/1559) by [@tianshuwang](https://github.com/tianshuwang)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-648 | CHANGELOG.md | Resource precedence for extensions, skills, prompts, themes, and slashcommand name collisions is now projectfirst (`cwd/.pi`) before userglobal (`~/.pi/agent`). If you relied on global resources overriding project resources with the same names, rename or reorder your resources. |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-649 | CHANGELOG.md | Extension registration conflicts no longer unload the entire later extension. All extensions stay loaded, and conflicting command/tool/flag names are resolved by first registration in load order. |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-650 | CHANGELOG.md | Fixed `.pi` folder being created unnecessarily when only reading settings. The folder is now only created when writing projectspecific settings. |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-651 | CHANGELOG.md | Fixed extensiondriven runtime theme changes to persist in settings so `/settings` reflects the active `currentTheme` after `ctx.ui.setTheme(...)` ([#1483](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/pull/1483) by [@ferologics](https://github.com/ferologics)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-652 | CHANGELOG.md | Fixed interactive mode freezes during large streaming `write` tool calls by using incremental syntax highlighting while partial arguments stream, with a final full rehighlight after toolcall arguments complete. |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-653 | CHANGELOG.md | Externalized koffi from bun binary builds, reducing archive sizes by ~15MB per platform (e.g. darwinarm64: 43MB > 28MB). Koffi's Windowsonly `.node` file is now shipped alongside the Windows binary only. |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-654 | CHANGELOG.md | Added default skill autodiscovery for `.agents/skills` locations. Pi now discovers project skills from `.agents/skills` in `cwd` and ancestor directories (up to git repo root, or filesystem root when not in a repo), and global skills from `~/.agents/skills`, in addition to existing `.pi` skill paths. |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-655 | CHANGELOG.md | Added Gemini 3.1 model catalog entries for all builtin providers that currently expose it: `google`, `googlevertex`, `opencode`, `openrouter`, and `vercelaigateway`. |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-656 | CHANGELOG.md | Added Claude Opus 4.6 Thinking to the `googleantigravity` model catalog. |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-657 | CHANGELOG.md | `SettingsManager` persistence semantics changed for SDK consumers. Setters now update inmemory state immediately and queue disk writes. Code that requires durable ondisk settings must call `await settingsManager.flush()`. |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-658 | CHANGELOG.md | `AuthStorage` constructor is no longer public. Use static factories (`AuthStorage.create(...)`, `AuthStorage.fromStorage(...)`, `AuthStorage.inMemory(...)`). This breaks code that used `new AuthStorage(...)` directly. |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-659 | CHANGELOG.md | Added `SettingsManager.drainErrors()` for callercontrolled settings I/O error handling without managerside console output. |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-660 | CHANGELOG.md | Added auth storage backends (`FileAuthStorageBackend`, `InMemoryAuthStorageBackend`) and `AuthStorage.fromStorage(...)` for storagefirst auth persistence wiring. |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-661 | CHANGELOG.md | Added Anthropic `claudesonnet46` model fallback entry to generated model definitions. |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-662 | CHANGELOG.md | `SettingsManager` now uses scoped storage abstraction with perscope locked read/merge/write persistence for global and project settings. |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-663 | CHANGELOG.md | Fixed project settings persistence to preserve unrelated external edits via mergeonwrite, while still applying inmemory changes for modified keys. |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-664 | CHANGELOG.md | Fixed auth credential persistence to preserve unrelated external edits to `auth.json` via locked read/merge/write updates. |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-665 | CHANGELOG.md | Fixed auth load/persist error surfacing by buffering errors and exposing them via `AuthStorage.drainErrors()`. |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-666 | CHANGELOG.md | Added `transport` setting (`"sse"`, `"websocket"`, `"auto"`) to `/settings` and `settings.json` for providers that support multiple transports (currently `openaicodex` via OpenAI Codex Responses). |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-667 | CHANGELOG.md | Interactive mode now applies transport changes immediately to the active agent session. |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-668 | CHANGELOG.md | Settings migration now maps legacy `websockets: boolean` to the new `transport` setting. |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-669 | CHANGELOG.md | Added MiniMax M2.5 model entries for `minimax`, `minimaxcn`, `openrouter`, and `vercelaigateway` providers, plus `minimaxm2.5free` for `opencode`. |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-670 | CHANGELOG.md | Extension terminal input interception via `terminal_input`, allowing extensions to consume or transform raw input before normal TUI handling. See [docs/extensions.md](docs/extensions.md). |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-671 | CHANGELOG.md | Expanded CLI model selection: `model` now supports `provider/id`, fuzzy matching, and `:<thinking>` suffixes. See [README.md](README.md) and [docs/models.md](docs/models.md). |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-672 | CHANGELOG.md | Safer package source handling with stricter git source parsing and improved local path normalization. See [docs/packages.md](docs/packages.md). |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-673 | CHANGELOG.md | New builtin model definition `gpt5.3codexspark` for OpenAI and OpenAI Codex providers. |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-674 | CHANGELOG.md | Improved OpenAI stream robustness for malformed trailing toolcall JSON in partial chunks. |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-675 | CHANGELOG.md | Added builtin GLM5 model support via z.ai and OpenRouter provider catalogs. |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-676 | CHANGELOG.md | `ContextUsage.tokens` and `ContextUsage.percent` are now `number | null`. After compaction, context token count is unknown until the next LLM response, so these fields return `null`. Extensions that read `ContextUsage` must handle the `null` case. Removed `usageTokens`, `trailingTokens`, and `lastUsageIndex` fields from `ContextUsage` (implementation details that should not have been public) ([#1382](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/pull/1382) by [@ferologics](https://github.com/ferologics)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-677 | CHANGELOG.md | Git source parsing is now strict without `git:` prefix: only protocol URLs are treated as git (`https://`, `http://`, `ssh://`, `git://`). Shorthand sources like `github.com/org/repo` and `git@github.com:org/repo` now require the `git:` prefix. ([#1426](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/issues/1426)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-678 | CHANGELOG.md | Added extension event forwarding for message and tool execution lifecycles (`message_start`, `message_update`, `message_end`, `tool_execution_start`, `tool_execution_update`, `tool_execution_end`) ([#1375](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/pull/1375) by [@sumeet](https://github.com/sumeet)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-679 | CHANGELOG.md | Added `terminal_input` extension event to intercept, consume, or transform raw terminal input before normal TUI handling. |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-680 | CHANGELOG.md | Added `gpt5.3codexspark` model definition for OpenAI and OpenAI Codex providers (research preview). |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-681 | CHANGELOG.md | Routed GitHub Copilot Claude 4.x models through Anthropic Messages API, with updated Copilot header handling for Claude model requests. |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-682 | CHANGELOG.md | Fixed context usage percentage in footer showing stale precompaction values. After compaction the footer now shows `?/200k` until the next LLM response provides accurate usage ([#1382](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/pull/1382) by [@ferologics](https://github.com/ferologics)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-683 | CHANGELOG.md | Fixed `_checkCompaction()` using the first compaction entry instead of the latest, which could cause incorrect overflow detection with multiple compactions ([#1382](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/pull/1382) by [@ferologics](https://github.com/ferologics)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-684 | CHANGELOG.md | `model` now works without `provider`, supports `provider/id` syntax, fuzzy matching, and `:<thinking>` suffix (e.g., `model sonnet:high`, `model openai/gpt4o`) ([#1350](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/pull/1350) by [@mitsuhiko](https://github.com/mitsuhiko)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-685 | CHANGELOG.md | Fixed local package path normalization for extension sources while tightening git source parsing rules ([#1426](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/issues/1426)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-686 | CHANGELOG.md | Fixed extension terminal input listeners not being cleared during session resets, which could leave stale handlers active. |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-687 | CHANGELOG.md | Fixed Termux bootstrap package name for `fd` installation ([#1433](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/pull/1433)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-688 | CHANGELOG.md | Fixed `@` file autocomplete fuzzy matching to prioritize pathprefix and segment matches for nested paths ([#1423](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/issues/1423)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-689 | CHANGELOG.md | Fixed OpenAI streaming toolcall parsing to tolerate malformed trailing JSON in partial chunks ([#1424](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/issues/1424)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-690 | CHANGELOG.md | Extensions can trigger a full runtime reload via `ctx.reload()`, useful for hotreloading configuration or restarting the agent. See [docs/extensions.md](docs/extensions.md) and the [`reloadruntime` example](examples/extensions/reloadruntime.ts) ([#1371](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/issues/1371)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-691 | CHANGELOG.md | Short CLI disable aliases: `ne` (`noextensions`), `ns` (`noskills`), and `np` (`noprompttemplates`) for faster interactive usage and scripting. |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-692 | CHANGELOG.md | `/export` HTML now includes collapsible tool input schemas (parameter names, types, and descriptions), improving session review and sharing workflows ([#1416](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/pull/1416) by [@marchellodev](https://github.com/marchellodev)). |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-693 | CHANGELOG.md | `pi.getAllTools()` now exposes tool parameters in addition to name and description, enabling richer extension integrations ([#1416](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/pull/1416) by [@marchellodev](https://github.com/marchellodev)). |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-694 | CHANGELOG.md | Added `ctx.reload()` to the extension API for programmatic runtime reload ([#1371](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/issues/1371)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-695 | CHANGELOG.md | Added short aliases for disable flags: `ne` for `noextensions`, `ns` for `noskills`, `np` for `noprompttemplates` |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-696 | CHANGELOG.md | `/export` HTML now includes tool input schema (parameter names, types, descriptions) in a collapsible section under each tool ([#1416](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/pull/1416) by [@marchellodev](https://github.com/marchellodev)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-697 | CHANGELOG.md | `pi.getAllTools()` now returns tool parameters in addition to name and description ([#1416](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/pull/1416) by [@marchellodev](https://github.com/marchellodev)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-698 | CHANGELOG.md | Fixed extension source parsing so dotprefixed local paths (for example `.pi/extensions/foo.ts`) are treated as local paths instead of git URLs |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-699 | CHANGELOG.md | Fixed fd/rg download failing on Windows due to `unzip` not being available; now uses `tar` for both `.tar.gz` and `.zip` extraction, with proper error reporting ([#1348](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/issues/1348)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-700 | CHANGELOG.md | Fixed RPC mode documentation incorrectly stating `ctx.hasUI` is `false`; it is `true` because dialog and fireandforget UI methods work via the RPC subprotocol. Also documented missing unsupported/degraded methods (`pasteToEditor`, `getAllThemes`, `getTheme`, `setTheme`) ([#1411](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/pull/1411) by [@aliou](https://github.com/aliou)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-701 | CHANGELOG.md | Fixed `rg` not available in bash tool by downloading it at startup alongside `fd` ([#1348](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/issues/1348)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-702 | CHANGELOG.md | Fixed `customcompaction` example to use `ModelRegistry` ([#1387](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/issues/1387)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-703 | CHANGELOG.md | Google providers now support full JSON Schema in tool declarations (anyOf, oneOf, const, etc.) ([#1398](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/issues/1398) by [@jarib](https://github.com/jarib)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-704 | CHANGELOG.md | Reverted incorrect Antigravity model change: `claudeopus46thinking` back to `claudeopus45thinking` (model does not exist on Antigravity endpoint) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-705 | CHANGELOG.md | Updated the Antigravity system instruction to a more compact version for Google Gemini CLI compatibility |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-706 | CHANGELOG.md | Corrected opencode context windows for Claude Sonnet 4 and 4.5 ([#1383](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/issues/1383)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-707 | CHANGELOG.md | Fixed subagent example unknownagent errors to include available agent names ([#1414](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/pull/1414) by [@dnouri](https://github.com/dnouri)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-708 | CHANGELOG.md | Emacsstyle kill ring (`ctrl+k`/`ctrl+y`/`alt+y`) and undo (`ctrl+z`) in the editor input ([#1373](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/pull/1373) by [@Perlence](https://github.com/Perlence)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-709 | CHANGELOG.md | OpenRouter `auto` model alias (`openrouter:auto`) for automatic model routing ([#1361](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/pull/1361) by [@yogasanas](https://github.com/yogasanas)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-710 | CHANGELOG.md | Extensions can programmatically paste content into the editor via `pasteToEditor` in the extension UI context. See [docs/extensions.md](docs/extensions.md) ([#1351](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/pull/1351) by [@kaofelix](https://github.com/kaofelix)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-711 | CHANGELOG.md | `pi <package> help` and invalid subcommands now show helpful output instead of failing silently ([#1347](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/pull/1347) by [@ferologics](https://github.com/ferologics)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-712 | CHANGELOG.md | Added `pasteToEditor` to extension UI context for programmatic editor paste ([#1351](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/pull/1351) by [@kaofelix](https://github.com/kaofelix)) |

| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1326 | CHANGELOG.md | Settings: `hooks` and `customTools` arrays replaced with single `extensions` array |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1327 | CHANGELOG.md | CLI: `hook` and `tool` flags replaced with `extension` / `e` |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1328 | CHANGELOG.md | Directories: `hooks/`, `tools/` → `extensions/`; `commands/` → `prompts/` |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1329 | CHANGELOG.md | Types: See type renames above |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1330 | CHANGELOG.md | SDK: See SDK migration above |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1331 | CHANGELOG.md | Extensions can have their own `package.json` with dependencies (resolved via jiti) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1332 | CHANGELOG.md | Documentation: `docs/hooks.md` and `docs/customtools.md` merged into `docs/extensions.md` |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1333 | CHANGELOG.md | Examples: `examples/hooks/` and `examples/customtools/` merged into `examples/extensions/` |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1334 | CHANGELOG.md | README: Extensions section expanded with custom tools, commands, events, state persistence, shortcuts, flags, and UI examples |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1335 | CHANGELOG.md | SDK: `customTools` option now accepts `ToolDefinition[]` directly (simplified from `Array<{ path?, tool }>`) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1336 | CHANGELOG.md | SDK: `extensions` option accepts `ExtensionFactory[]` for inline extensions |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1337 | CHANGELOG.md | SDK: `additionalExtensionPaths` replaces both `additionalHookPaths` and `additionalCustomToolPaths` |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1338 | CHANGELOG.md | Hook API: `ctx.ui.setTitle(title)` allows hooks to set the terminal window/tab title ([#446](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/pull/446) by [@aliou](https://github.com/aliou)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1339 | CHANGELOG.md | Expanded keybinding documentation to list all 32 supported symbol keys with notes on ctrl+symbol behavior ([#450](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/pull/450) by [@kaofelix](https://github.com/kaofelix)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1340 | CHANGELOG.md | Hook API: `pi.getActiveTools()` and `pi.setActiveTools(toolNames)` for dynamically enabling/disabling tools from hooks |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1341 | CHANGELOG.md | Hook API: `pi.getAllTools()` to enumerate all configured tools (builtin via tools or default, plus custom tools) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1342 | CHANGELOG.md | Hook API: `pi.registerFlag(name, options)` and `pi.getFlag(name)` for hooks to register custom CLI flags (parsed automatically) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1343 | CHANGELOG.md | Hook API: `pi.registerShortcut(shortcut, options)` for hooks to register custom keyboard shortcuts using `KeyId` (e.g., `Key.shift("p")`). Conflicts with builtin shortcuts are skipped, conflicts between hooks logged as warnings. |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1344 | CHANGELOG.md | Hook API: `ctx.ui.setWidget(key, content)` for status displays above the editor. Accepts either a string array or a component factory function. |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1345 | CHANGELOG.md | Hook API: `theme.strikethrough(text)` for strikethrough text styling |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1346 | CHANGELOG.md | Hook API: `before_agent_start` handlers can now return `systemPromptAppend` to dynamically append text to the system prompt for that turn. Multiple hooks' appends are concatenated. |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1347 | CHANGELOG.md | Hook API: `before_agent_start` handlers can now return multiple messages (all are injected, not just the first) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1348 | CHANGELOG.md | `/hotkeys` command now shows hookregistered shortcuts in a separate "Hooks" section |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1349 | CHANGELOG.md | New example hook: `planmode.ts`  Claude Codestyle readonly exploration mode: |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1350 | CHANGELOG.md | Toggle via `/plan` command, `Shift+P` shortcut, or `plan` CLI flag |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1351 | CHANGELOG.md | Readonly tools: `read`, `bash`, `grep`, `find`, `ls` (no `edit`/`write`) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1352 | CHANGELOG.md | Bash commands restricted to nondestructive operations (blocks `rm`, `mv`, `git commit`, `npm install`, etc.) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1353 | CHANGELOG.md | Interactive prompt after each response: execute plan, stay in plan mode, or refine |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1354 | CHANGELOG.md | Todo list widget showing progress with checkboxes and strikethrough for completed items |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1355 | CHANGELOG.md | Each todo has a unique ID; agent marks items done by outputting `[DONE:id]` |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1356 | CHANGELOG.md | Progress updates via `agent_end` hook (parses completed items from final message) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1357 | CHANGELOG.md | `/todos` command to view current plan progress |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1358 | CHANGELOG.md | Shows `⏸ plan` indicator in footer when in plan mode, `📋 2/5` when executing |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1359 | CHANGELOG.md | State persists across sessions (including todo progress) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1360 | CHANGELOG.md | New example hook: `tools.ts`  Interactive `/tools` command to enable/disable tools with session persistence |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1361 | CHANGELOG.md | New example hook: `pirate.ts`  Demonstrates `systemPromptAppend` to make the agent speak like a pirate |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1362 | CHANGELOG.md | Tool registry now contains all builtin tools (read, bash, edit, write, grep, find, ls) even when `tools` limits the initially active set. Hooks can enable any tool from the registry via `pi.setActiveTools()`. |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1363 | CHANGELOG.md | System prompt now automatically rebuilds when tools change via `setActiveTools()`, updating tool descriptions and guidelines to match the new tool set |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1364 | CHANGELOG.md | Hook errors now display full stack traces for easier debugging |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1365 | CHANGELOG.md | Event bus (`pi.events`) for tool/hook communication: shared pub/sub between custom tools and hooks |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1366 | CHANGELOG.md | Custom tools now have `pi.sendMessage()` to send messages directly to the agent session without needing the event bus |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1367 | CHANGELOG.md | `sendMessage()` supports `deliverAs: "nextTurn"` to queue messages for the next user prompt |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1368 | CHANGELOG.md | Removed image placeholders after copy & paste, replaced with inserting image file paths directly. ([#442](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/pull/442) by [@mitsuhiko](https://github.com/mitsuhiko)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1369 | CHANGELOG.md | Fixed potential text decoding issues in bash executor by using streaming TextDecoder instead of Buffer.toString() |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1370 | CHANGELOG.md | External editor (CtrlG) now shows full pasted content instead of `[paste #N ...]` placeholders ([#444](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/pull/444) by [@aliou](https://github.com/aliou)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1371 | CHANGELOG.md | Key detection functions removed from `@mariozechner/pitui`: All `isXxx()` key detection functions (`isEnter()`, `isEscape()`, `isCtrlC()`, etc.) have been removed. Use `matchesKey(data, keyId)` instead (e.g., `matchesKey(data, "enter")`, `matchesKey(data, "ctrl+c")`). This affects hooks and custom tools that use `ctx.ui.custom()` with keyboard input handling. ([#405](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/pull/405)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1372 | CHANGELOG.md | Clipboard image paste support via `Ctrl+V`. Images are saved to a temp file and attached to the message. Works on macOS, Windows, and Linux (X11). ([#419](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/issues/419)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1373 | CHANGELOG.md | Configurable keybindings via `~/.pi/agent/keybindings.json`. All keyboard shortcuts (editor navigation, deletion, app actions like model cycling, etc.) can now be customized. Supports multiple bindings per action. ([#405](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/pull/405) by [@hjanuschka](https://github.com/hjanuschka)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1374 | CHANGELOG.md | `/quit` and `/exit` slash commands to gracefully exit the application. Unlike double Ctrl+C, these properly await hook and custom tool cleanup handlers before exiting. ([#426](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/pull/426) by [@benvargas](https://github.com/benvargas)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1375 | CHANGELOG.md | Subagent example README referenced incorrect filename `subagent.ts` instead of `index.ts` ([#427](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/pull/427) by [@Whamp](https://github.com/Whamp)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1376 | CHANGELOG.md | `listmodels` no longer shows Google Vertex AI models without explicit authentication configured |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1377 | CHANGELOG.md | JPEG/GIF/WebP images not displaying in terminals using Kitty graphics protocol (Kitty, Ghostty, WezTerm). The protocol requires PNG format, so nonPNG images are now converted before display. |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1378 | CHANGELOG.md | Version check URL typo preventing update notifications from working ([#423](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/pull/423) by [@skuridin](https://github.com/skuridin)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1379 | CHANGELOG.md | Large images exceeding Anthropic's 5MB limit now retry with progressive quality/size reduction ([#424](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/pull/424) by [@mitsuhiko](https://github.com/mitsuhiko)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1380 | CHANGELOG.md | `$ARGUMENTS` syntax for custom slash commands as alternative to `$@` for all arguments joined. Aligns with patterns used by Claude, Codex, and OpenCode. Both syntaxes remain fully supported. ([#418](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/pull/418) by [@skuridin](https://github.com/skuridin)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1381 | CHANGELOG.md | Slash commands and hook commands now work during streaming: Previously, using a slash command or hook command while the agent was streaming would crash with "Agent is already processing". Now: |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1382 | CHANGELOG.md | Hook commands execute immediately (they manage their own LLM interaction via `pi.sendMessage()`) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1383 | CHANGELOG.md | Filebased slash commands are expanded and queued via steer/followUp |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1384 | CHANGELOG.md | `steer()` and `followUp()` now expand filebased slash commands and error on hook commands (hook commands cannot be queued) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1385 | CHANGELOG.md | `prompt()` accepts new `streamingBehavior` option (`"steer"` or `"followUp"`) to specify queueing behavior during streaming |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1386 | CHANGELOG.md | RPC `prompt` command now accepts optional `streamingBehavior` field |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1387 | CHANGELOG.md | Slash command argument substitution now processes positional arguments (`$1`, `$2`, etc.) before allarguments (`$@`, `$ARGUMENTS`) to prevent recursive substitution when argument values contain dollardigit patterns like `$100`. ([#418](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/pull/418) by [@skuridin](https://github.com/skuridin)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1388 | CHANGELOG.md | Shell commands without context contribution: use `!!command` to execute a bash command that is shown in the TUI and saved to session history but excluded from LLM context. Useful for running commands you don't want the AI to see. ([#414](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/issues/414)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1389 | CHANGELOG.md | Edit tool diff not displaying in TUI due to race condition between async preview computation and tool execution |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1390 | CHANGELOG.md | Queue API replaced with steer/followUp: The `queueMessage()` method has been split into two methods with different delivery semantics ([#403](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/issues/403)): |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1391 | CHANGELOG.md | `steer(text)`: Interrupts the agent midrun (Enter while streaming). Delivered after current tool execution. |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1392 | CHANGELOG.md | `followUp(text)`: Waits until the agent finishes (Alt+Enter while streaming). Delivered only when agent stops. |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1393 | CHANGELOG.md | Settings renamed: `queueMode` setting renamed to `steeringMode`. Added new `followUpMode` setting. Old settings.json files are migrated automatically. |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1394 | CHANGELOG.md | AgentSession methods renamed: |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1395 | CHANGELOG.md | `queueMessage()` → `steer()` and `followUp()` |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1396 | CHANGELOG.md | `queueMode` getter → `steeringMode` and `followUpMode` getters |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1397 | CHANGELOG.md | `setQueueMode()` → `setSteeringMode()` and `setFollowUpMode()` |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1398 | CHANGELOG.md | `queuedMessageCount` → `pendingMessageCount` |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1399 | CHANGELOG.md | `getQueuedMessages()` → `getSteeringMessages()` and `getFollowUpMessages()` |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1400 | CHANGELOG.md | `clearQueue()` now returns `{ steering: string[], followUp: string[] }` |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1401 | CHANGELOG.md | `hasQueuedMessages()` → `hasPendingMessages()` |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1402 | CHANGELOG.md | Hook API signature changed: `pi.sendMessage()` second parameter changed from `triggerTurn?: boolean` to `options?: { triggerTurn?, deliverAs? }`. Use `deliverAs: "followUp"` for followup delivery. Affects both hooks and internal `sendHookMessage()` method. |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1403 | CHANGELOG.md | RPC API changes: |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1404 | CHANGELOG.md | `queue_message` command → `steer` and `follow_up` commands |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1405 | CHANGELOG.md | `set_queue_mode` command → `set_steering_mode` and `set_follow_up_mode` commands |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1406 | CHANGELOG.md | `RpcSessionState.queueMode` → `steeringMode` and `followUpMode` |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1407 | CHANGELOG.md | Settings UI: "Queue mode" setting split into "Steering mode" and "Followup mode" |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1408 | CHANGELOG.md | Configurable doubleescape action: choose whether doubleescape with empty editor opens `/tree` (default) or `/branch`. Configure via `/settings` or `doubleEscapeAction` in settings.json ([#404](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/issues/404)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1409 | CHANGELOG.md | Vertex AI provider (`googlevertex`): access Gemini models via Google Cloud Vertex AI using Application Default Credentials ([#300](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/pull/300) by [@defaultanton](https://github.com/defaultanton)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1410 | CHANGELOG.md | Builtin provider overrides in `models.json`: override just `baseUrl` to route a builtin provider through a proxy while keeping all its models, or define `models` to fully replace the provider ([#406](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/pull/406) by [@yevhen](https://github.com/yevhen)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1411 | CHANGELOG.md | Automatic image resizing: images larger than 2000x2000 are resized for better model compatibility. Original dimensions are injected into the prompt. Controlled via `/settings` or `images.autoResize` in settings.json. ([#402](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/pull/402) by [@mitsuhiko](https://github.com/mitsuhiko)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1412 | CHANGELOG.md | Alt+Enter keybind to queue followup messages while agent is streaming |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1413 | CHANGELOG.md | `Theme` and `ThemeColor` types now exported for hooks using `ctx.ui.custom()` |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1414 | CHANGELOG.md | Terminal window title now displays "pi  dirname" to identify which project session you're in ([#407](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/pull/407) by [@kaofelix](https://github.com/kaofelix)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1415 | CHANGELOG.md | Editor component now uses word wrapping instead of characterlevel wrapping for better readability ([#382](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/pull/382) by [@nickseelert](https://github.com/nickseelert)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1416 | CHANGELOG.md | `/model` selector now opens instantly instead of waiting for OAuth token refresh. Token refresh is deferred until a model is actually used. |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1417 | CHANGELOG.md | Shift+Space, Shift+Backspace, and Shift+Delete now work correctly in Kittyprotocol terminals (Kitty, WezTerm, etc.) instead of being silently ignored ([#411](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/pull/411) by [@nathyong](https://github.com/nathyong)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1418 | CHANGELOG.md | `AgentSession.prompt()` now throws if called while the agent is already streaming, preventing race conditions. Use `steer()` or `followUp()` to queue messages during streaming. |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1419 | CHANGELOG.md | Ctrl+C now works like Escape in selector components, so mashing Ctrl+C will eventually close the program ([#400](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/pull/400) by [@mitsuhiko](https://github.com/mitsuhiko)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1420 | CHANGELOG.md | Model selector no longer allows negative index when pressing arrow keys before models finish loading ([#398](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/pull/398) by [@mitsuhiko](https://github.com/mitsuhiko)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1421 | CHANGELOG.md | Type guard functions (`isBashToolResult`, etc.) now exported at runtime, not just in type declarations ([#397](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/issues/397)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1422 | CHANGELOG.md | Existing sessions are automatically migrated (v1 → v2) on first load. No manual action required. |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1423 | CHANGELOG.md | Type renames: |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1424 | CHANGELOG.md | `HookEventContext` → `HookContext` |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1425 | CHANGELOG.md | `HookCommandContext` is now a new interface extending `HookContext` with session control methods |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1426 | CHANGELOG.md | Event changes: |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1427 | CHANGELOG.md | The monolithic `session` event is now split into granular events: `session_start`, `session_before_switch`, `session_switch`, `session_before_branch`, `session_branch`, `session_before_compact`, `session_compact`, `session_shutdown` |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1428 | CHANGELOG.md | `session_before_switch` and `session_switch` events now include `reason: "new" | "resume"` to distinguish between `/new` and `/resume` |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1429 | CHANGELOG.md | New `session_before_tree` and `session_tree` events for `/tree` navigation (hook can provide custom branch summary) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1430 | CHANGELOG.md | New `before_agent_start` event: inject messages before the agent loop starts |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1431 | CHANGELOG.md | New `context` event: modify messages nondestructively before each LLM call |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1432 | CHANGELOG.md | Session entries are no longer passed in events. Use `ctx.sessionManager.getEntries()` or `ctx.sessionManager.getBranch()` instead |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1433 | CHANGELOG.md | API changes: |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1434 | CHANGELOG.md | `pi.send(text, attachments?)` → `pi.sendMessage(message, triggerTurn?)` (creates `CustomMessageEntry`) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1435 | CHANGELOG.md | New `pi.appendEntry(customType, data?)` for hook state persistence (not in LLM context) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1436 | CHANGELOG.md | New `pi.registerCommand(name, options)` for custom slash commands (handler receives `HookCommandContext`) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1437 | CHANGELOG.md | New `pi.registerMessageRenderer(customType, renderer)` for custom TUI rendering |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1438 | CHANGELOG.md | New `ctx.isIdle()`, `ctx.abort()`, `ctx.hasQueuedMessages()` for agent state (available in all events) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1439 | CHANGELOG.md | New `ctx.ui.editor(title, prefill?)` for multiline text editing with Ctrl+G external editor support |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1440 | CHANGELOG.md | New `ctx.ui.custom(component)` for full TUI component rendering with keyboard focus |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1441 | CHANGELOG.md | New `ctx.ui.setStatus(key, text)` for persistent status text in footer (multiple hooks can set their own) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1442 | CHANGELOG.md | New `ctx.ui.theme` getter for styling text with theme colors |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1443 | CHANGELOG.md | `ctx.exec()` moved to `pi.exec()` |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1444 | CHANGELOG.md | `ctx.sessionFile` → `ctx.sessionManager.getSessionFile()` |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1445 | CHANGELOG.md | New `ctx.modelRegistry` and `ctx.model` for API key resolution |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1446 | CHANGELOG.md | HookCommandContext (slash commands only): |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1447 | CHANGELOG.md | `ctx.waitForIdle()`  wait for agent to finish streaming |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1448 | CHANGELOG.md | `ctx.newSession(options?)`  create new sessions with optional setup callback |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1449 | CHANGELOG.md | `ctx.fork(entryId)  fork from a specific entry, creating a new session file |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1450 | CHANGELOG.md | `ctx.navigateTree(targetId, options?)`  navigate the session tree |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1451 | CHANGELOG.md | Removed: |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1452 | CHANGELOG.md | `hookTimeout` setting (hooks no longer have timeouts; use Ctrl+C to abort) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1453 | CHANGELOG.md | `resolveApiKey` parameter (use `ctx.modelRegistry.getApiKey(model)`) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1454 | CHANGELOG.md | Type renames: |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1455 | CHANGELOG.md | `CustomAgentTool` → `CustomTool` |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1456 | CHANGELOG.md | `ToolAPI` → `CustomToolAPI` |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1457 | CHANGELOG.md | `ToolContext` → `CustomToolContext` |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1458 | CHANGELOG.md | `ToolSessionEvent` → `CustomToolSessionEvent` |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1459 | CHANGELOG.md | Execute signature changed: |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1460 | CHANGELOG.md | `ctx.isIdle()`  check if agent is streaming |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1461 | CHANGELOG.md | `ctx.hasQueuedMessages()`  check if user has queued messages (skip interactive prompts) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-1462 | CHANGELOG.md | `ctx.abort()`  abort current operation (fireandforget) |
