| G-PI-CHANGELOG-001 | CHANGELOG.md | Fixed `ProcessTerminal` to fall back to `COLUMNS` and `LINES` before defaulting to 80x24 dimensions ([#4004](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/issues/4004)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-002 | CHANGELOG.md | Fixed editor rendering artifacts for Thai Sara Am and Lao AM vowel characters ([#3904](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/issues/3904)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-003 | CHANGELOG.md | Fixed duplicate printable characters from Kitty keyboard protocol CSIu plus raw character input on layouts such as Italian ([#3780](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/issues/3780)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-004 | CHANGELOG.md | Fixed CSIu Ctrl+letter decoding inside bracketed paste, so pasted modifiedkey escape sequences no longer become literal editor text ([#3623](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/pull/3623) by [@Exrun94](https://github.com/Exrun94)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-005 | CHANGELOG.md | Kept OSC 9;4 terminal progress alive with periodic updates so Ghostty does not clear the indicator during longrunning agent work ([#3610](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/issues/3610)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-006 | CHANGELOG.md | Added `setProgress(active: boolean)` to the `Terminal` interface for OSC 9;4 progress indicator support |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-007 | CHANGELOG.md | Added generic stacked autocomplete support for extension wrappers via `AutocompleteProvider.shouldTriggerFileCompletion?()` and `#` as a natural autocomplete trigger alongside `@` ([#2983](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/issues/2983)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-008 | CHANGELOG.md | Fixed `@` autocomplete fuzzy search to follow symlinked directories and include symlinked paths in results ([#3507](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/issues/3507)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-009 | CHANGELOG.md | Added `LoaderIndicatorOptions` and `Loader.setIndicator()` support for custom loader frames and animation intervals, allowing TUI consumers to use animated, static, or hidden loader indicators ([#3413](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/issues/3413)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-010 | CHANGELOG.md | Fixed `@` autocomplete fuzzy search to stop matching against the full base path for plain queries, so worktree or cwd paths containing the query text no longer crowd out real results such as `@plan` suggestions ([#2778](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/issues/2778)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-011 | CHANGELOG.md | Fixed xterm `modifyOtherKeys` printable input so shifted uppercase letters insert correctly in the editor and shifted letter bindings parse and match consistently ([#3436](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/issues/3436)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-012 | CHANGELOG.md | Added OSC 8 hyperlink rendering for markdown links when the terminal advertises support. Introduces a public `hyperlink(text, url)` helper and a `setCapabilities()` test override in `packages/tui` ([#3248](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/pull/3248) by [@ofa1](https://github.com/ofa1)). |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-013 | CHANGELOG.md | Added `argumentHint` to `SlashCommand` interface, displayed before the description in the autocomplete dropdown ([#2780](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/pull/2780) by [@andresvi94](https://github.com/andresvi94)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-014 | CHANGELOG.md | Tightened `detectCapabilities()` to default `hyperlinks: false` for unknown terminals and to force `hyperlinks: false` under tmux/screen (including nested sessions where the outer terminal would otherwise advertise OSC 8). Prevents markdown link URLs from disappearing on terminals that silently swallow OSC 8 sequences ([#3248](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/pull/3248)). |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-015 | CHANGELOG.md | Fixed Zellij `Shift+Enter` regressions by reverting the Zellijspecific Kitty keyboard query bypass and restoring the previous keyboard negotiation behavior ([#3259](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/issues/3259)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-016 | CHANGELOG.md | Fixed markdown strikethrough parsing to require strict doubletilde delimiters (`~~text~~`) with nonwhitespace boundaries, preventing accidental strikethrough from loose tilde usage. |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-017 | CHANGELOG.md | Added full helper support for Kitty `super`modified shortcuts, including combinations such as `super+k`, `super+enter`, and `ctrl+super+k` ([#2979](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/issues/2979)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-018 | CHANGELOG.md | Fixed Ctrl+Alt letter key matching in tmux by falling through from legacy ESCprefixed handling to CSIu and xterm `modifyOtherKeys` parsing when the legacy form does not match ([#2989](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/pull/2989) by [@kaofelix](https://github.com/kaofelix)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-019 | CHANGELOG.md | Fixed `Container.render()` stack overflow on long sessions by replacing `Array.push(...spread)` with a loopbased push, preventing `RangeError: Maximum call stack size exceeded` when child output exceeds the V8 call stack argument limit ([#2651](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/issues/2651)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-020 | CHANGELOG.md | Fixed editor stickycolumn tracking around paste markers so vertical cursor navigation restores the column from before the cursor entered a paste marker instead of jumping inside or past pasted content ([#3092](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/pull/3092) by [@Perlence](https://github.com/Perlence)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-021 | CHANGELOG.md | Fixed TUI test suite failures caused by render throttle scheduling: added `VirtualTerminal.waitForRender()` helper that waits for the 16ms throttled render pipeline to settle before asserting viewport state ([#3076](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/pull/3076) by [@aliou](https://github.com/aliou)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-022 | CHANGELOG.md | Fixed render scheduling under heavy streaming output by coalescing `requestRender()` calls to a 16ms frame budget while preserving immediate `requestRender(true)` behavior. |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-023 | CHANGELOG.md | Fixed markdown H1 headings ending with inline code from leaking underline styling into trailing line padding |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-024 | CHANGELOG.md | Fixed slashcommand argument autocomplete to await async `getArgumentCompletions()` results and ignore invalid return values, preventing crashes when extension commands provide asynchronous completions ([#2719](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/issues/2719)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-025 | CHANGELOG.md | Fixed noncapturing overlay padding from inflating scrollback and corrupting the viewport on terminal widen ([#2758](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/pull/2758) by [@dotBeeps](https://github.com/dotBeeps)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-026 | CHANGELOG.md | Fixed TUI cell size response handling to consume only exact `CSI 6 ; height ; width t` replies, so bare `Escape` is no longer swallowed while waiting for terminal image metadata ([#2661](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/issues/2661)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-027 | CHANGELOG.md | Fixed Kitty keyboard protocol keypad functional keys to normalize to logical digits, symbols, and navigation keys, so numpad input in terminals such as iTerm2 no longer inserts Private Use Area gibberish or gets ignored ([#2650](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/issues/2650)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-028 | CHANGELOG.md | Added support for `PI_TUI_WRITE_LOG` directory paths, creating a unique log file (`tui<timestamp><pid>.log`) per instance for easier debugging of multiple pi sessions ([#2508](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/pull/2508) by [@mrexodia](https://github.com/mrexodia)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-029 | CHANGELOG.md | Fixed blockquote text color breaking after inline links (and other inline elements) due to missing style restoration prefix |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-030 | CHANGELOG.md | Fixed slashcommand Tab completion from immediately chaining into argument autocomplete after completing the command name, restoring flows like `/model` that submit into a selector dialog ([#2577](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/issues/2577)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-031 | CHANGELOG.md | Fixed stale content and incorrect viewport tracking after TUI content shrinks or transient components inflate the working area ([#2126](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/pull/2126) by [@Perlence](https://github.com/Perlence)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-032 | CHANGELOG.md | Fixed `@` autocomplete to debounce editortriggered searches, cancel inflight `fd` lookups cleanly, and keep suggestions visible while results refresh ([#1278](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/issues/1278)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-033 | CHANGELOG.md | Fixed `truncateToWidth()` to stream truncation for very large strings, keep contiguous prefixes, and always terminate truncated SGR styling safely ([#2447](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/issues/2447)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-034 | CHANGELOG.md | Fixed markdown heading styling being lost after inline code spans within headings |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-035 | CHANGELOG.md | Fixed shared keybinding resolution to stop user overrides from evicting unrelated default shortcuts such as selector confirm and editor cursor keys ([#2455](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/issues/2455)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-036 | CHANGELOG.md | Fixed Termux software keyboard height changes from forcing fullscreen redraws and replaying TUI history on every toggle ([#2467](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/issues/2467)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-037 | CHANGELOG.md | Replaced the editoronly keybinding store with a single global keybindings manager in `@mariozechner/pitui`. TUI keybinding ids are now namespaced: `cursorUp` > `tui.editor.cursorUp`, `cursorDown` > `tui.editor.cursorDown`, `cursorLeft` > `tui.editor.cursorLeft`, `cursorRight` > `tui.editor.cursorRight`, `cursorWordLeft` > `tui.editor.cursorWordLeft`, `cursorWordRight` > `tui.editor.cursorWordRight`, `cursorLineStart` > `tui.editor.cursorLineStart`, `cursorLineEnd` > `tui.editor.cursorLineEnd`, `jumpForward` > `tui.editor.jumpForward`, `jumpBackward` > `tui.editor.jumpBackward`, `pageUp` > `tui.editor.pageUp`, `pageDown` > `tui.editor.pageDown`, `deleteCharBackward` > `tui.editor.deleteCharBackward`, `deleteCharForward` > `tui.editor.deleteCharForward`, `deleteWordBackward` > `tui.editor.deleteWordBackward`, `deleteWordForward` > `tui.editor.deleteWordForward`, `deleteToLineStart` > `tui.editor.deleteToLineStart`, `deleteToLineEnd` > `tui.editor.deleteToLineEnd`, `yank` > `tui.editor.yank`, `yankPop` > `tui.editor.yankPop`, `undo` > `tui.editor.undo`, `newLine` > `tui.input.newLine`, `submit` > `tui.input.submit`, `tab` > `tui.input.tab`, `copy` > `tui.input.copy`, `selectUp` > `tui.select.up`, `selectDown` > `tui.select.down`, `selectPageUp` > `tui.select.pageUp`, `selectPageDown` > `tui.select.pageDown`, `selectConfirm` > `tui.select.confirm`, `selectCancel` > `tui.select.cancel`. `keybindings.json` stays backward compatible because each keybinding definition maps the new internal id back to the existing public config key. Apps extend `interface Keybindings` via declaration merging, create one manager with both TUI and app definitions, then install it with `setKeybindings(...)` ([#2391](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/issues/2391)) |

| G-PI-CHANGELOG-144 | CHANGELOG.md | Keyboard shortcuts (Ctrl+C, Ctrl+D, etc.) now work on nonLatin keyboard layouts (Russian, Ukrainian, Bulgarian, etc.) in terminals supporting Kitty keyboard protocol with alternate key reporting ([#718](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/pull/718) by [@dannote](https://github.com/dannote)) |

| G-PI-CHANGELOG-147 | CHANGELOG.md | `showOverlay()` now returns `OverlayHandle` with `hide()`, `setHidden(boolean)`, `isHidden()` for programmatic visibility control ([#667](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/pull/667) by [@nicobailon](https://github.com/nicobailon)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-148 | CHANGELOG.md | New exported types: `OverlayAnchor`, `OverlayHandle`, `OverlayMargin`, `OverlayOptions`, `SizeValue` ([#667](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/pull/667) by [@nicobailon](https://github.com/nicobailon)) |

| G-PI-CHANGELOG-150 | CHANGELOG.md | Overlay compositing crash when rendered lines exceed terminal width due to complex ANSI/OSC sequences (e.g., hyperlinks in subagent output) ([#667](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/pull/667) by [@nicobailon](https://github.com/nicobailon)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-151 | CHANGELOG.md | `SettingsListOptions` with `enableSearch` for fuzzy filtering in `SettingsList` ([#643](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/pull/643) by [@ninlds](https://github.com/ninlds)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-152 | CHANGELOG.md | `pageUp` and `pageDown` key support with `selectPageUp`/`selectPageDown` editor actions ([#662](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/pull/662) by [@aliou](https://github.com/aliou)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-153 | CHANGELOG.md | Numbered list items showing "1." for all items when code blocks break list continuity ([#660](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/pull/660) by [@ogulcancelik](https://github.com/ogulcancelik)) |

| G-PI-CHANGELOG-156 | CHANGELOG.md | Cursor now moves to end of content on exit, preventing status line from being overwritten ([#629](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/pull/629) by [@tallshort](https://github.com/tallshort)) |

| G-PI-CHANGELOG-171 | CHANGELOG.md | Symbol key support in keybinding system: `SymbolKey` type with 32 symbol keys, `Key` constants (e.g., `Key.backtick`, `Key.comma`), updated `matchesKey()` and `parseKey()` to handle symbol input ([#450](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/pull/450) by [@kaofelix](https://github.com/kaofelix)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-172 | CHANGELOG.md | `Editor.getExpandedText()` method that returns text with paste markers expanded to their actual content ([#444](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/pull/444) by [@aliou](https://github.com/aliou)) |

([#405](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/pull/405)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-174 | CHANGELOG.md | `Editor.insertTextAtCursor(text)` method for programmatic text insertion ([#419](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/issues/419)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-175 | CHANGELOG.md | `EditorKeybindingsManager` for configurable editor keybindings. ([#405](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/pull/405) by [@hjanuschka](https://github.com/hjanuschka)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-176 | CHANGELOG.md | Key detection refactored: consolidated `is()` functions into generic `matchesKey(data, keyId)` function that accepts key identifiers like `"ctrl+c"`, `"shift+enter"`, `"alt+left"`, etc. |

| G-PI-CHANGELOG-179 | CHANGELOG.md | Shift+Space, Shift+Backspace, and Shift+Delete now work correctly in Kittyprotocol terminals (Kitty, WezTerm, etc.) instead of being silently ignored ([#411](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/pull/411) by [@nathyong](https://github.com/nathyong)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-180 | CHANGELOG.md | `visibleWidth()` now strips OSC 8 hyperlink sequences, fixing text wrapping for clickable links ([#396](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/pull/396) by [@Cursivez](https://github.com/Cursivez)) |

| G-PI-CHANGELOG-186 | CHANGELOG.md | `visibleWidth()` reimplemented with graphemebased width calculation, 10x faster on Bun and ~15% faster on Node ([#369](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/pull/369) by [@nathyong](https://github.com/nathyong)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-187 | CHANGELOG.md | Markdown component now renders HTML tags as plain text instead of silently dropping them ([#359](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/issues/359)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-188 | CHANGELOG.md | Crash in `visibleWidth()` and grapheme iteration when encountering undefined code points ([#372](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/pull/372) by [@HACKERC](https://github.com/HACKERC)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-189 | CHANGELOG.md | ZWJ emoji sequences (rainbow flag, family, etc.) now render with correct width instead of being split into multiple characters ([#369](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/pull/369) by [@nathyong](https://github.com/nathyong)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-190 | CHANGELOG.md | Autospace before pasted file paths: When pasting a file path (starting with `/`, `~`, or `.`) and the cursor is after a word character, a space is automatically prepended for better readability. Useful when dragging screenshots from macOS. ([#307](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/pull/307) by [@mitsuhiko](https://github.com/mitsuhiko)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-191 | CHANGELOG.md | Word navigation for Input component: Added Ctrl+Left/Right and Alt+Left/Right support for wordbyword cursor movement. ([#306](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/pull/306) by [@kim0](https://github.com/kim0)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-192 | CHANGELOG.md | Full Unicode input: Input component now accepts Unicode characters beyond ASCII. ([#306](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/pull/306) by [@kim0](https://github.com/kim0)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-193 | CHANGELOG.md | Readlinestyle Ctrl+W: Now skips trailing whitespace before deleting the preceding word, matching standard readline behavior. ([#306](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/pull/306) by [@kim0](https://github.com/kim0)) |

| G-PI-CHANGELOG-001 | CHANGELOG.md | Migrated the web UI's TypeBoxbased tool definitions and runtime dependency from `@sinclair/typebox` 0.34.x to `typebox` 1.x. Install and import from `typebox` instead of `@sinclair/typebox` when embedding or extending `@mariozechner/piwebui` with shared TypeBox schemas ([#3112](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/issues/3112)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-002 | CHANGELOG.md | Render SVG artifact previews through a blobbacked image instead of injecting untrusted SVG markup into the page DOM ([#3552](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/issues/3552)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-003 | CHANGELOG.md | Exported `CustomProviderDialog` from `@mariozechner/piwebui` ([#2267](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/issues/2267)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-004 | CHANGELOG.md | `onModelSelect` callback on `AgentInterface` and `ChatPanel.setAgent` config |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-005 | CHANGELOG.md | `allowedProviders` filter on `ModelSelector.open()` to restrict visible models |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-006 | CHANGELOG.md | `onClose` callback on `SettingsDialog.open()` |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-007 | CHANGELOG.md | `state_change` event emitted by Agent on `setModel()` and `setThinkingLevel()` |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-008 | CHANGELOG.md | Subsequencebased fuzzy search in model selector (replaces substring matching) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-009 | CHANGELOG.md | `openaicodex` and `githubcopilot` to `shouldUseProxyForProvider` |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-010 | CHANGELOG.md | Anthropic test model updated from `claude35haiku20241022` to `claudehaiku45` |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-011 | CHANGELOG.md | `AgentInterface` clears streaming container on `message_end` to prevent duplicate tool rendering |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-012 | CHANGELOG.md | Build `@mariozechner/piwebui` with `tsc` instead of `tsgo` so Lit decoratorbased state updates rerender correctly. |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-013 | CHANGELOG.md | Made model selector search caseinsensitive by normalizing query tokens, fixing autocapitalized mobile input filtering ([#1443](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/issues/1443)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-014 | CHANGELOG.md | Exported `CustomProviderCard`, `ProviderKeyInput`, `AbortedMessage`, and `ToolMessageDebugView` components for custom UIs ([#1015](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/issues/1015)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-015 | CHANGELOG.md | Updated tsgo to 7.0.0dev.20260120.1 for decorator support ([#873](https://github.com/badlogic/pimono/issues/873)) |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-016 | CHANGELOG.md | Agent class moved to `@mariozechner/piagentcore`: The `Agent` class, `AgentState`, and related types are no longer exported from this package. Import them from `@mariozechner/piagentcore` instead. |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-017 | CHANGELOG.md | Transport abstraction removed: `ProviderTransport`, `AppTransport`, `AgentTransport` interface, and related types have been removed. The `Agent` class now uses `streamFn` for custom streaming. |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-018 | CHANGELOG.md | `AppMessage` renamed to `AgentMessage`: Now imported from `@mariozechner/piagentcore`. Custom message types use declaration merging on `CustomAgentMessages` interface. |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-019 | CHANGELOG.md | `UserMessageWithAttachments` is now a custom message type: Has `role: "userwithattachments"` instead of `role: "user"`. Use `isUserMessageWithAttachments()` type guard. |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-020 | CHANGELOG.md | `CustomMessages` interface removed: Use declaration merging on `CustomAgentMessages` from `@mariozechner/piagentcore` instead. |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-021 | CHANGELOG.md | `agent.appendMessage()` removed: Use `agent.queueMessage()` instead. |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-022 | CHANGELOG.md | Agent event types changed: `AgentInterface` now handles new event types from `@mariozechner/piagentcore`: `message_start`, `message_end`, `message_update`, `turn_start`, `turn_end`, `agent_start`, `agent_end`. |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-023 | CHANGELOG.md | `defaultConvertToLlm`: Default message transformer that handles `UserMessageWithAttachments` and `ArtifactMessage`. Apps can extend this for custom message types. |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-024 | CHANGELOG.md | `convertAttachments`: Utility to convert `Attachment[]` to LLM content blocks (images and extracted document text). |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-025 | CHANGELOG.md | `isUserMessageWithAttachments` / `isArtifactMessage`: Type guard functions for custom message types. |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-026 | CHANGELOG.md | `createStreamFn`: Creates a stream function with CORS proxy support. Reads proxy settings on each call for dynamic configuration. |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-027 | CHANGELOG.md | Default `streamFn` and `getApiKey`: `AgentInterface` now sets sensible defaults if not provided: |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-028 | CHANGELOG.md | `streamFn`: Uses `createStreamFn` with proxy settings from storage |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-029 | CHANGELOG.md | `getApiKey`: Reads from `providerKeys` storage |
| G-PI-CHANGELOG-030 | CHANGELOG.md | Proxy utilities exported: `applyProxyIfNeeded`, `shouldUseProxyForProvider`, `isCorsError`, `createStreamFn` |

| G-PI-PACKAGES-016 | packages.md | SSH URLs use your configured SSH keys automatically (respects `~/.ssh/config`). |

| G-PI-EXTENSIONS-001 | extensions.md | Key capabilities: |
| G-PI-EXTENSIONS-002 | extensions.md | Custom tools  Register tools the LLM can call via `pi.registerTool()` |
| G-PI-EXTENSIONS-003 | extensions.md | Event interception  Block or modify tool calls, inject context, customize compaction |
| G-PI-EXTENSIONS-004 | extensions.md | User interaction  Prompt users via `ctx.ui` (select, confirm, input, notify) |
| G-PI-EXTENSIONS-005 | extensions.md | Custom UI components  Full TUI components with keyboard input via `ctx.ui.custom()` for complex interactions |
| G-PI-EXTENSIONS-006 | extensions.md | Custom commands  Register commands like `/mycommand` via `pi.registerCommand()` |
| G-PI-EXTENSIONS-007 | extensions.md | Session persistence  Store state that survives restarts via `pi.appendEntry()` |
| G-PI-EXTENSIONS-008 | extensions.md | Custom rendering  Control how tool calls/results and messages appear in TUI |

| G-PI-EXTENSIONS-040 | extensions.md | Single file  simplest, for small extensions: |

| G-PI-EXTENSIONS-042 | extensions.md | Package with dependencies  for extensions that need npm packages: |
| G-PI-EXTENSIONS-043 | extensions.md | `message_start` and `message_end` fire for user, assistant, and toolResult messages. |
| G-PI-EXTENSIONS-044 | extensions.md | `message_update` fires for assistant streaming updates. |
| G-PI-EXTENSIONS-045 | extensions.md | `message_end` handlers can return `{ message }` to replace the finalized message. The replacement must keep the same `role`. |
| G-PI-EXTENSIONS-046 | extensions.md | `tool_execution_start` is emitted in assistant source order during the preflight phase |
| G-PI-EXTENSIONS-047 | extensions.md | `tool_execution_update` events may interleave across tools |
| G-PI-EXTENSIONS-048 | extensions.md | `tool_execution_end` is emitted in tool completion order after each tool is finalized |
| G-PI-EXTENSIONS-049 | extensions.md | final `toolResult` message events are still emitted later in assistant source order |
| G-PI-EXTENSIONS-050 | extensions.md | Mutations to `event.input` affect the actual tool execution |
| G-PI-EXTENSIONS-051 | extensions.md | Later `tool_call` handlers see mutations made by earlier handlers |
| G-PI-EXTENSIONS-052 | extensions.md | No revalidation is performed after your mutation |
| G-PI-EXTENSIONS-053 | extensions.md | Return values from `tool_call` only control blocking via `{ block: true, reason?: string }` |
| G-PI-EXTENSIONS-054 | extensions.md | Handlers run in extension load order |
| G-PI-EXTENSIONS-055 | extensions.md | Each handler sees the latest result after previous handler changes |
| G-PI-EXTENSIONS-056 | extensions.md | Handlers can return partial patches (`content`, `details`, or `isError`); omitted fields keep their current values |
| G-PI-EXTENSIONS-057 | extensions.md | Processing order: |
| G-PI-EXTENSIONS-058 | extensions.md | Results: |
| G-PI-EXTENSIONS-059 | extensions.md | `continue`  pass through unchanged (default if handler returns nothing) |
| G-PI-EXTENSIONS-060 | extensions.md | `transform`  modify text/images, then continue to expansion |
| G-PI-EXTENSIONS-061 | extensions.md | `handled`  skip agent entirely (first handler to return this wins) |
| G-PI-EXTENSIONS-062 | extensions.md | `fetch(..., { signal: ctx.signal })` |
| G-PI-EXTENSIONS-063 | extensions.md | model calls that accept `signal` |
| G-PI-EXTENSIONS-064 | extensions.md | file or process helpers that accept `AbortSignal` |
| G-PI-EXTENSIONS-065 | extensions.md | Interactive mode: Deferred until the agent becomes idle (after processing all queued steering and followup messages). |
| G-PI-EXTENSIONS-066 | extensions.md | RPC mode: Deferred until the next idle state (after completing the current command response, when waiting for the next command). |
| G-PI-EXTENSIONS-067 | extensions.md | Print mode: Noop. The process exits automatically when all prompts are processed. |
| G-PI-EXTENSIONS-068 | extensions.md | During `before_agent_start`, this reflects chained systemprompt changes made so far for the current turn. |
| G-PI-EXTENSIONS-069 | extensions.md | It does not include later `context` message mutations. |
| G-PI-EXTENSIONS-070 | extensions.md | It does not include `before_provider_request` payload rewrites. |
| G-PI-EXTENSIONS-071 | extensions.md | If laterloaded extensions run after yours, they can still change what is ultimately sent. |
| G-PI-EXTENSIONS-072 | extensions.md | `parentSession`: parent session file to record in the new session header |
| G-PI-EXTENSIONS-073 | extensions.md | `setup`: mutate the new session's `SessionManager` before `withSession` runs |
| G-PI-EXTENSIONS-074 | extensions.md | `withSession`: run postswitch work against a fresh replacementsession context. Do not use captured old `pi` / command `ctx`; see [Session replacement lifecycle and footguns](#sessionreplacementlifecycleandfootguns). |
| G-PI-EXTENSIONS-075 | extensions.md | `position`: `"before"` (default) forks before the selected user message, restoring that prompt into the editor |
| G-PI-EXTENSIONS-076 | extensions.md | `position`: `"at"` duplicates the active path through the selected entry without restoring editor text |
| G-PI-EXTENSIONS-077 | extensions.md | `withSession`: run postswitch work against a fresh replacementsession context. Do not use captured old `pi` / command `ctx`; see [Session replacement lifecycle and footguns](#sessionreplacementlifecycleandfootguns). |
| G-PI-EXTENSIONS-078 | extensions.md | `summarize`: Whether to generate a summary of the abandoned branch |
| G-PI-EXTENSIONS-079 | extensions.md | `customInstructions`: Custom instructions for the summarizer |
| G-PI-EXTENSIONS-080 | extensions.md | `replaceInstructions`: If true, `customInstructions` replaces the default prompt instead of being appended |
| G-PI-EXTENSIONS-081 | extensions.md | `label`: Label to attach to the branch summary entry (or target entry if not summarizing) |
| G-PI-EXTENSIONS-082 | extensions.md | `withSession`: run postswitch work against a fresh replacementsession context. Do not use captured old `pi` / command `ctx`; see [Session replacement lifecycle and footguns](#sessionreplacementlifecycleandfootguns). |
| G-PI-EXTENSIONS-083 | extensions.md | `withSession` runs only after the old session has emitted `session_shutdown`, the old runtime has been torn down, the replacement session has been rebound, and the new extension instance has already received `session_start`. |
| G-PI-EXTENSIONS-084 | extensions.md | The callback still executes in the original closure, not inside the new extension instance. That means your old extension instance may already have run its shutdown cleanup before `withSession` starts. |
| G-PI-EXTENSIONS-085 | extensions.md | Captured old `pi` / old command `ctx` sessionbound objects are stale after replacement and will throw if used. Use only the `ctx` passed to `withSession` for sessionbound work. |
| G-PI-EXTENSIONS-086 | extensions.md | Previously extracted raw objects are still your responsibility. For example, if you capture `const sm = ctx.sessionManager` before replacement, `sm` is still the old `SessionManager` object. Do not reuse it after replacement. |
| G-PI-EXTENSIONS-087 | extensions.md | Code in `withSession` should assume any state invalidated by your `session_shutdown` handler is already gone. Only capture plain data that survives shutdown cleanly, such as strings, ids, and serialized config. |
| G-PI-EXTENSIONS-088 | extensions.md | `await ctx.reload()` emits `session_shutdown` for the current extension runtime |
| G-PI-EXTENSIONS-089 | extensions.md | It then reloads resources and emits `session_start` with `reason: "reload"` and `resources_discover` with reason `"reload"` |
| G-PI-EXTENSIONS-090 | extensions.md | The currently running command handler still continues in the old call frame |
| G-PI-EXTENSIONS-091 | extensions.md | Code after `await ctx.reload()` still runs from the prereload version |
| G-PI-EXTENSIONS-092 | extensions.md | Code after `await ctx.reload()` must not assume old inmemory extension state is still valid |
| G-PI-EXTENSIONS-093 | extensions.md | After the handler returns, future commands/events/tool calls use the new extension version |
| G-PI-EXTENSIONS-094 | extensions.md | Important: `promptGuidelines` bullets are appended flat to the `Guidelines` section with no tool name prefix. Each guideline must name the tool it refers to — avoid "Use this tool when..." because the LLM cannot tell which tool "this" means. Write "Use my_tool when..." instead. |
| G-PI-EXTENSIONS-095 | extensions.md | Options: |
| G-PI-EXTENSIONS-096 | extensions.md | `deliverAs`  Delivery mode: |
| G-PI-EXTENSIONS-097 | extensions.md | `"steer"` (default)  Queues the message while streaming. Delivered after the current assistant turn finishes executing its tool calls, before the next LLM call. |
| G-PI-EXTENSIONS-098 | extensions.md | `"followUp"`  Waits for agent to finish. Delivered only when agent has no more tool calls. |
| G-PI-EXTENSIONS-099 | extensions.md | `"nextTurn"`  Queued for next user prompt. Does not interrupt or trigger anything. |
| G-PI-EXTENSIONS-100 | extensions.md | `triggerTurn: true`  If agent is idle, trigger an LLM response immediately. Only applies to `"steer"` and `"followUp"` modes (ignored for `"nextTurn"`). |
| G-PI-EXTENSIONS-101 | extensions.md | Options: |
| G-PI-EXTENSIONS-102 | extensions.md | `deliverAs`  Required when agent is streaming: |
| G-PI-EXTENSIONS-103 | extensions.md | `"steer"`  Queues the message for delivery after the current assistant turn finishes executing its tool calls |
| G-PI-EXTENSIONS-104 | extensions.md | `"followUp"`  Waits for agent to finish all tools |
| G-PI-EXTENSIONS-105 | extensions.md | `builtin` for builtin tools |
| G-PI-EXTENSIONS-106 | extensions.md | `sdk` for tools passed via `createAgentSession({ customTools })` |
| G-PI-EXTENSIONS-107 | extensions.md | extension source metadata for tools registered by extensions |
| G-PI-EXTENSIONS-108 | extensions.md | Config options: |
| G-PI-EXTENSIONS-109 | extensions.md | `name`  Display name for the provider in UI such as `/login`. |
| G-PI-EXTENSIONS-110 | extensions.md | `baseUrl`  API endpoint URL. Required when defining models. |
| G-PI-EXTENSIONS-111 | extensions.md | `apiKey`  API key or environment variable name. Required when defining models (unless `oauth` provided). |
| G-PI-EXTENSIONS-112 | extensions.md | `api`  API type: `"anthropicmessages"`, `"openaicompletions"`, `"openairesponses"`, etc. |
| G-PI-EXTENSIONS-113 | extensions.md | `headers`  Custom headers to include in requests. |
| G-PI-EXTENSIONS-114 | extensions.md | `authHeader`  If true, adds `Authorization: Bearer` header automatically. |
| G-PI-EXTENSIONS-115 | extensions.md | `models`  Array of model definitions. If provided, replaces all existing models for this provider. Model definitions can set `baseUrl` to override the provider endpoint for that model. |
| G-PI-EXTENSIONS-116 | extensions.md | `oauth`  OAuth provider config for `/login` support. When provided, the provider appears in the login menu. |
| G-PI-EXTENSIONS-117 | extensions.md | `streamSimple`  Custom streaming implementation for nonstandard APIs. |
| G-PI-EXTENSIONS-118 | extensions.md | Important: `promptGuidelines` bullets are appended flat to the `Guidelines` section with no tool name prefix or grouping. Each guideline must name the tool it refers to — avoid "Use this tool when..." because the LLM cannot tell which tool "this" means. Write "Use my_tool when..." instead. |
| G-PI-EXTENSIONS-119 | extensions.md | Signaling errors: To mark a tool execution as failed (sets `isError: true` on the result and reports it to the LLM), throw an error from `execute`. Returning a value never sets the error flag regardless of what properties you include in the return object. |
| G-PI-EXTENSIONS-120 | extensions.md | Early termination: Return `terminate: true` from `execute()` to hint that the automatic followup LLM call should be skipped after the current tool batch. This only takes effect when every finalized tool result in that batch is terminating. See [examples/extensions/structuredoutput.ts](../examples/extensions/structuredoutput.ts) for a minimal example where the agent ends on a final structuredoutput tool call. |
| G-PI-EXTENSIONS-121 | extensions.md | Important: Use `StringEnum` from `@mariozechner/piai` for string enums. `Type.Union`/`Type.Literal` doesn't work with Google's API. |
| G-PI-EXTENSIONS-122 | extensions.md | Argument preparation: `prepareArguments(args)` is optional. If defined, it runs before schema validation and before `execute()`. Use it to mimic an older accepted input shape when pi resumes an older session whose stored tool call arguments no longer match the current schema. Return the object you want validated against `parameters`. Keep the public schema strict. Do not add deprecated compatibility fields to `parameters` just to keep old resumed sessions working. |
| G-PI-EXTENSIONS-123 | extensions.md | Rendering: Builtin renderer inheritance is resolved per slot. Execution override and rendering override are independent. If your override omits `renderCall`, the builtin `renderCall` is used. If your override omits `renderResult`, the builtin `renderResult` is used. If your override omits both, the builtin renderer is used automatically (syntax highlighting, diffs, etc.). This lets you wrap builtin tools for logging or access control without reimplementing the UI. |
| G-PI-EXTENSIONS-124 | extensions.md | Prompt metadata: `promptSnippet` and `promptGuidelines` are not inherited from the builtin tool. If your override should keep those prompt instructions, define them on the override explicitly. |
| G-PI-EXTENSIONS-125 | extensions.md | Your implementation must match the exact result shape, including the `details` type. The UI and session logic depend on these shapes for rendering and state tracking. |

| G-PI-RPC-001 | rpc.md | Note for Node.js/TypeScript users: If you're building a Node.js application, consider using `AgentSession` directly from `@mariozechner/picodingagent` instead of spawning a subprocess. See [`src/core/agentsession.ts`](../src/core/agentsession.ts) for the API. For a subprocessbased TypeScript client, see [`src/modes/rpc/rpcclient.ts`](../src/modes/rpc/rpcclient.ts). |
| G-PI-RPC-002 | rpc.md | `provider <name>`: Set the LLM provider (anthropic, openai, google, etc.) |
| G-PI-RPC-003 | rpc.md | `model <pattern>`: Model pattern or ID (supports `provider/id` and optional `:<thinking>`) |
| G-PI-RPC-004 | rpc.md | `nosession`: Disable session persistence |
| G-PI-RPC-005 | rpc.md | `sessiondir <path>`: Custom session storage directory |
| G-PI-RPC-006 | rpc.md | Commands: JSON objects sent to stdin, one per line |
| G-PI-RPC-007 | rpc.md | Responses: JSON objects with `type: "response"` indicating command success/failure |
| G-PI-RPC-008 | rpc.md | Events: Agent events streamed to stdout as JSON lines |
| G-PI-RPC-009 | rpc.md | Split records on `\n` only |
| G-PI-RPC-010 | rpc.md | Accept optional `\r\n` input by stripping a trailing `\r` |
| G-PI-RPC-011 | rpc.md | Do not use generic line readers that treat Unicode separators as newlines |
| G-PI-RPC-012 | rpc.md | During streaming: If the agent is already streaming, you must specify `streamingBehavior` to queue the message: |
| G-PI-RPC-013 | rpc.md | `"steer"`: Queue the message while the agent is running. It is delivered after the current assistant turn finishes executing its tool calls, before the next LLM call. |
| G-PI-RPC-014 | rpc.md | `"followUp"`: Wait until the agent finishes. Message is delivered only when agent stops. |
| G-PI-RPC-015 | rpc.md | Extension commands: If the message is an extension command (e.g., `/mycommand`), it executes immediately even during streaming. Extension commands manage their own LLM interaction via `pi.sendMessage()`. |
| G-PI-RPC-016 | rpc.md | Input expansion: Skill commands (`/skill:name`) and prompt templates (`/template`) are expanded before sending/queueing. |
| G-PI-RPC-017 | rpc.md | `"all"`: Deliver all steering messages after the current assistant turn finishes executing its tool calls |
| G-PI-RPC-018 | rpc.md | `"oneatatime"`: Deliver one steering message per completed assistant turn (default) |
| G-PI-RPC-019 | rpc.md | `"all"`: Deliver all followup messages when agent finishes |
| G-PI-RPC-020 | rpc.md | `"oneatatime"`: Deliver one followup message per agent completion (default) |
| G-PI-RPC-021 | rpc.md | How bash results reach the LLM: |
| G-PI-RPC-022 | rpc.md | `name`: Command name (invoke with `/name`) |
| G-PI-RPC-023 | rpc.md | `description`: Humanreadable description (optional for extension commands) |
| G-PI-RPC-024 | rpc.md | `source`: What kind of command: |
| G-PI-RPC-025 | rpc.md | `"extension"`: Registered via `pi.registerCommand()` in an extension |
